summary: Frontend-only UI test of MOD Handover Diary 'New conversation' modal. All requested behaviours PASS: DM staff list populated with Cpl James Reed + Sgt Test QA; search filters to Reed; Group shows 'Send to everyone at this site (2 staff)' toggle; toggle ON hides staff picker and shows all-note; Create with toggle ON succeeds and thread appears (TEST_Everyone_Group); Broadcast also supports send-to-all and Create succeeds (Broadcast thread appears); Group with toggle OFF and no staff selected shows blocking alert 'Pick staff, or choose Send to everyone at this site.' Modal reuses testids: new-thread-modal, new-thread-kind-dm/-group/-channel/-announcement, new-thread-staff-list, new-thread-search, new-thread-send-all, new-thread-all-note, new-thread-submit — all present and correct.

test_results_detail.A_dm_staff_dropdown: PASS — staff list renders 2 rows (Cpl James Reed CPL, Sgt Test QA PT INSTRUCTOR). Search 'Reed' narrows to only Cpl James Reed.
test_results_detail.B1_group_toggle_visible: PASS — 'Send to everyone at this site (2 staff)' toggle visible on Group chip.
test_results_detail.B2_group_send_all_create: PASS — toggle ON hides staff picker, shows note 'This will be sent to all staff on this site.'; Create with optional name 'TEST_Everyone_Group' succeeds, no alerts, modal closes, thread appears in list as GROUP · 3 MEMBERS.
test_results_detail.B3_broadcast_send_all_create: PASS — Broadcast chip shows same send-to-all toggle; toggling ON + Create succeeds; new Broadcast thread appears (3 MEMBERS: Cpl James Reed, Sgt Test QA + current user).
test_results_detail.B4_group_no_selection_blocks: PASS — with Group + send-all OFF + no staff picked, Create triggers window.alert 'Pick staff, or choose "Send to everyone at this site".' and modal remains open.

observations_and_minor_discrepancies: Handover Diary subtab data-testid is 'staffing-tab-comms' (spec said 'staffing-subtab-comms'). Not blocking; consider aliasing/adding a subtab-prefixed testid for consistency with rest of app if standardisation is desired.
'+ New' button data-testid is 'comms-new' (spec suggested 'new-thread-btn'). Not blocking.
Broadcast subject input placeholder is 'Subject (optional)' whereas Group uses 'Group name (optional)' — expected/appropriate.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider using a shadcn/HTML confirm/toast rather than window.alert() for the 'Pick staff or Send to everyone' validation — currently blocks the event loop and is not stylistically consistent with the rest of the modal.
Optional: expose alias data-testid 'staffing-subtab-comms' on the Handover Diary subtab for parity with review-request spec / other subtab naming conventions.
